scope: Third-party adjudication of the items three annotators disagreed on, for the fields that passed reliability.

excluded.freshness: alpha 0.47; needs a re-pilot, not a referee

verdict.reading: Departure 0.529 against a random-choice baseline of 0.500. Indistinguishable from the baseline: on these items the adjudicator's verdict is uncorrelated with the majority, so majority vote was effectively arbitrary here -- which does not by itself mean the population estimates move, because contested items are a small and low-weight slice. The switches are directional (PARTIAL->CORRECT x10), so the adjudicator applied a different threshold rather than choosing noisily.

supports.reading: Departure 0.363 against a random-choice baseline of 0.508. Below the baseline: the adjudicator agreed with the majority more often than chance, so majority vote carried real signal on the contested items. The switches are directional (PARTIAL->NO x27), so the adjudicator applied a different threshold rather than choosing noisily.
